## Problem to solve

What are you trying to do, and what gets in the way today? Concrete
workflows ("I want to bind a key that opens foto pre-filtered on my
browser windows") are much more useful than abstract features.

## Proposed solution

What should happen instead? If you have an idea about how it should look
or behave, describe it — keybindings, config keys, CLI flags.

## Alternatives you considered

Other tools, workarounds, or config tweaks you already tried.

## Trade-offs to keep in mind

foto is deliberately minimal: one static binary, no GTK/Qt, no webview,
no heavyweight dependencies. If your idea needs a new crate or a new
subsystem, please say why the benefit justifies it — a smaller design
that fits the existing architecture is more likely to be accepted.

## Checklist

- [ ] I checked the README and `foto --print-config` — this is not
      already possible with existing config keys or flags
- [ ] I searched existing issues for a similar request
